human_requirement: 有些角色要符合人物特性做一些修改是正常的，时迁这种偷偷摸摸的就没必要，武松，林冲这种肯定就站的笔直，要符合原著
supersedes: v3 blanket instruction that all seven characters must use disciplined soldier posture. Preserve historical requests/PNGs/QA as evidence, never rewrite exact generated requests.
common_rules: Natural mature adult anatomy; preserve each person's height/build rather than imposing identical head/leg ratios.
Pose must fit individual novel identity, current story condition and action; distinguish alert crouch from accidental deformed hunch.
Normal idle stance may differ from attack/stealth/bound/injury pose. Upright characters may bend dynamically during a real action.
Keep all directions/phases consistent in face, clothes, body size and foot anchors.
Current rescued seven remain unarmed and noncombatant; personality does not change HP/speed/attack/slots or owner routing.

shi_qian.posture: Slim nimble infiltrator; alert searching eyes, light flexible knees, weight slightly forward and lowered, modest functional lean from hips, arms close and hands ready to balance. No rigid parade stance or chest thrust; no exaggerated hump, elderly slump or deep squat.
shi_qian.novel_basis: Chapter identifies his climbing/infiltration work and depicts an agile flexible body and swift gait.
shi_qian.interpretation: Exact modest forward lean and low center of gravity are art direction inferred from novel skills and human instruction, not a quoted mandated angle.

wu_song.posture: Tall powerful and imposing; upright head/back, broad open chest and shoulders, grounded confident stance. Dynamic strikes may bend/rotate naturally; ordinary idle never timid or cramped.
wu_song.novel_basis: Tall impressive adult with extraordinary strength.
wu_song.scope: Current source sprites still require individual review; this profile is not a completion claim.

lin_chong.posture: Tall robust experienced instructor; straight upright bearing, level gaze, stable balanced feet, calm restrained strength. Keep distinctive mature head/beard and avoid timid slump.
lin_chong.novel_basis: Robust tall adult and Imperial Guard martial instructor.
lin_chong.scope: Existing directional production sprites still require individual review; no new sprites qualified by this file.

shi_xiu.posture: Fearless resolute martial adult; straight ready stance with alert eyes, naturally open shoulders. Avoid stiff identical parade stance. Rescued state keeps empty hands and short natural steps.
shi_xiu.novel_basis: Intervenes against a group bullying Yang Xiong; identifies lifelong martial training and willingness to help against injustice.
shi_xiu.interpretation: Resolute ready stance is art interpretation. Exact slimness, head proportions and cloth design are not prescribed by this passage.

qin_ming.posture: Powerful warrior; expansive stable chest and shoulders, direct forceful bearing, normal adult head/boots. Rescued foot-only variant has no mace or horse.
qin_ming.novel_basis: Military officer, impatient temperament, thunderous voice, exceptional strength and wolf-tooth mace.
qin_ming.interpretation: Broad shoulder silhouette and forceful idle are art interpretation; impatience does not require a collapsed hunch.

yang_lin.posture: Broad shoulders and narrow waist, mobile alert bearing with flexible natural knees; preserve current garment during this batch.
yang_lin.novel_basis: Described with round head, large ears, straight nose, square mouth, narrow waist and broad shoulders; experienced traveler familiar with local routes.
yang_lin.interpretation: Flexible stance is art interpretation. Spotted costume is current project design, not established by nickname alone; do not claim novel-mandated leopard clothing.

huang_xin.posture: Military officer bearing, naturally upright and steady; not rigid overarched chest.
huang_xin.novel_basis: Military dujian, commands the escort, confronts the ambush and organizes defense; Qin Ming trained his martial skills.
huang_xin.interpretation: Stern upright officer stance and armor silhouette are art interpretation, not exact physique mandated by the chapter.

wang_ying.posture: Naturally short adult with sturdy weight and individual rough bearing; keep adult head/limbs instead of stretching tall.
wang_ying.novel_basis: Explicit short-limbed build and coarse temperament, hence Short-legged Tiger nickname.
wang_ying.interpretation: Preserve short adult anatomy; broad stocky volume is project interpretation, not license for deformed or childlike proportions.

deng_fei.posture: Rugged alert martial bearing with individual shoulder stance and weight; preserve current hair/beard and brown costume consistently. Natural asymmetry allowed, no generic collapsed upper body.
deng_fei.novel_basis: Red eyes and formidable iron-chain fighter from Xiangyang, with wrestling background.
deng_fei.interpretation: Rugged stance, curly hair/beard and brown armor remain art/project interpretation; this chapter does not prescribe those exact features.
